crossRefs.note: Wail, you shepherds, and cry. Wallow in dust, you leader of the flock; for the days of your slaughter and of your…
For this, clothe yourself with sackcloth, lament and wail; for the fierce anger of Yahweh hasn’t turned back from us.

translations.web: A voice of the cry of the shepherds, and the wailing of the leader of the flock, for Yahweh destroys their pasture.
translations.bsb: Hear the cry of the shepherds, the wailing of the leaders of the flock, for the LORD is destroying their pasture.
translations.kjv: A voice of the cry of the shepherds, and an howling of the principal of the flock, shall be heard: for the LORD hath spoiled their pasture.
translations.asv: A voice of the cry of the shepherds, and the wailing of the principal of the flock! for Jehovah layeth waste their pasture.
